name: Hush-a-bye, baby
source:
The protagonist Nagai Kihiro is an idol that pretends to be so pure and innocent. Her outside may seem nice but she is actually a rough girl with a bad mouth who is always besieging her manager with selfish requests.

One day a Shinigami girl called Mori suddenly appears before Kihiro. Apparently she was supposed to die four years ago in an accident Mori told her, but because of Mori's mistake Kihiro was allowed to keep living.

Kihiro insists that she doesn't want to die so Mori makes a proposal, If Kihiro can get a boyfriend in seven days she will be allowed to live. Mori laughs and says it should be easy, right? But because of some trauma in the past Kihiro is bad at dealing with love.

After that Kihiro gets a new job where she has to act together with a new talent. So she presses herself to try and get a boyfriend among the noisy people around her, but it's more complicated then she thought.

With an exceedingly strange and dishonest motive the pretending to be pure girl starts her clumsy love strategy.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=231445]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角永井希尋是一名偶像，總是假裝清純無辜。她表面上親切可愛，實際上性格粗暴、說話刻薄，經常老是向經紀人提出任性要求。

一天，一個名叫Mori的死神少女突然出現在希尋面前。據Mori所說，希尋本應在四年前的一場事故中死去，卻因為她的失誤得以繼續活著。

希尋堅稱自己不想死，於是Mori提出一個條件：如果希尋能在七天內交到男朋友，就允許她活下去。Mori笑著說，這應該很簡單吧？可因為過去的創傷，希尋並不擅長面對愛情。

此後，希尋得到一份新工作，要與一名新人演員共同演出。她只好逼迫自己，嘗試從周圍吵鬧的人群中找一個男朋友，可事情遠比想像複雜。

懷著極其奇怪而不誠實的動機，這個裝清純的女孩，就此展開了她笨拙的戀愛計畫。
